Follow the job for Pidgin
1 · Check why cargo never move

Before, customer dey call and everybody dey find who know wetin happen.

Now, open KP-1042. The job show say na Ikeja desk dey handle am. Once terminal confirm release, Dispatch fit enter the release number.

Next: Check who fit carry am.

2 · Pick who go carry am

Check your own vans first. If none free, compare wetin other carriers go charge, when dem fit deliver and whether dem get proof of insurance.

The cheapest carrier for this example no show insurance proof. Martins fit approve the one wey get proof and fit reach on time.

Next: Follow the cargo till e reach.

3 · Follow cargo till e reach

Dispatch mark when driver pick am and when e reach. If delay happen, write who go handle am and when dem go check again. Enter delivery proof when the customer collect am.

Next: See wetin customer dey see.

4 · See wetin customer dey see for MONARCH Trade

Customer fit use the same KP-1042 number see when driver pick am and when e reach. If dem request another delivery, Knightpride desk go review am before dem accept.

5 · Tell us wetin you go change
